stem: In the tooth numbering system described, which quadrant corresponds to the lower left side of the face?
explanation: The numbering system assigns 1 to upper right, 2 to upper left, 3 to lower left, and 4 to lower right.
rationale: The numbering follows a clockwise or counter-clockwise path starting from the upper right.

optionExplanations.A: Quadrant 1 is designated for the upper right side of the face.
optionExplanations.B: Quadrant 2 refers to the upper left quadrant of the face.
optionExplanations.C: The numbering system assigns 1 to upper right, 2 to upper left, 3 to lower left, and 4 to lower right.
optionExplanations.D: Quadrant 4 represents the lower right side of the face.

source.hint: The numbering follows a clockwise or counter-clockwise path starting from the upper right.
